description: This file contains utility functions for handling multiple dispatch signatures, including supercedes, consistent, ambiguous, and ordering, used for resolving method signatures and ambiguities in a dispatch system.

classes.name: AmbiguityWarning
classes.description: Warning class used for ambiguity-related warnings

methods.name: supercedes
methods.description: Determines if signature A is strictly more specific than B

methods.name: consistent
methods.description: Checks if two signatures can satisfy both arguments simultaneously

methods.name: ambiguous
methods.description: Checks if signatures A and B are ambiguous (neither more specific)

methods.name: ambiguities
methods.description: Finds all pairs of signatures that are ambiguous

methods.name: super_signature
methods.description: Generates a signature that would break existing ambiguities

methods.name: edge
methods.description: Determines if signature A should be checked before B, with tie-breaker

methods.name: ordering
methods.description: Provides a topological order of signatures to check based on supercedes and edge relations
